title: UAAP: UST, Ateneo close 16-and-under campaigns with victories

blocks.text: University of Santo Tomas and Ateneo de Manila University closed their UAAP Season 89 High School Boys’ 16-and-under basketball tournament campaigns with victories, defeating University of the Philippines Integrated School and Adamson University, respectively, on Tuesday.
